notes: Frozen regression holdout. It is disjoint from rag_calibration.json by query id and query text and covers all six synthetic SOPs. It deliberately retains two retrieval failures observed in the historical 42-query report and adds multi-document questions. These labels were written before the split evaluation was run; results must be reported honestly and never used to edit labels or tune thresholds. This is a regression holdout, not an unseen real-customer benchmark.
